Run the agent locally on any machine or server — test apps behind a firewall, on a private network, or even on localhost. Free tier open. No card required.

Triage issues, trigger audits, and build reports by asking. Available on the Growth and Compliance plans, OAuth sign-in, connected in under 60 seconds.

The Terminal Graph shows every agent's live terminal wired to the card it owns. The HUD shows who is working and lets you attach to any of them from the browser. Claude Code, Codex and Grok run side by side, self-hosted in Docker.
topics: Software Engineering, Developer Tools, Artificial Intelligence, GitHub

name: Arcovia
tagline: Architecture Intelligence for React & Next.js Projects

Built for teams that want to understand, measure, and continuously improve their architecture.
topics: Open Source, Software Engineering, Developer Tools, GitHub

name: PDR Generator
tagline: From SRR to a board-ready PDR draft in hours, not months.
description: Most PDR tools assemble documents. This one runs the numbers underneath them. Import your SRR/SDR package: PDR Generator runs Monte Carlo over every allocation, returns a probability of breach against each committed value, estimates joint cost & schedule confidence, and ranks mitigations by return per $1k. Every figure traces to its source sheet, and where your package has a gap, it says so instead of inventing a number. Runs 100% offline. ITAR/EAR friendly by architecture.
topics: Productivity, Software Engineering, Artificial Intelligence, GitHub

name: SKI

All on your machine, free. Available on Mac & Windows.

name: Prefactor

We score every agent run in real time, surface quality regressions and drift as they happen, and show engineering teams exactly how their agents are performing at scale. Built for the teams shipping agents to customers.
